Enterprise Service Pillars

Unified Operations Under One Sovereign Engine

Why manufacturers, multi-warehouse distributors, and retail chains migrate to AntaresERP.

Double-Entry Accounting

GAAP & IFRS compliant general ledger. Automated journal entries, multi-currency balance sheets, accounts payable/receivable aging, and real-time trial balances.

Instant financial close

Multi-Location WMS

Manage physical bin locations, lot/batch tracking, expiration schedules, and pick-pack-ship workflows across unlimited regional distribution centers.

Barcode scanner ready

Offline Retail POS

Ultra-responsive cashier point-of-sale terminal. Continues ringing sales, scanning barcodes, and printing receipts even when store internet drops, auto-syncing upon reconnection.

Zero internet downtime

Sovereign Data Storage

All supplier contracts, internal margin sheets, and banking details reside inside your own private PostgreSQL database. 100% audit-proof data ownership.

Zero third-party vendor leaks
